items.q: What does the parcel look like on delivery?
items.a: Deliveries arrive in an opaque, robust, completely neutral box — no logo, no insignia, no copy that hints at the contents. Shipping documents show only the legal operator name (Velvet Studio SRL); the courier never knows what is inside.

items.q: How do you guarantee hygiene for rentals?
items.a: Between rentals we run a five-stage clinical protocol: professional detergent wash, medical-grade broad-spectrum disinfection, 15-minute UV-C sterilisation, controlled drying, and sealed packaging. Each companion is re-sealed before each new delivery.

items.q: Can I fully customise a doll for purchase?
items.a: Yes. Purchase orders let you choose shape, height, skin tone, eye colour, hair, makeup, bust, hips, articulated skeleton, thermal module, and reactive voice module. Your advisor sends previews before final approval.

Medical-grade platinum-cure silicone or surgical-grade TPE — both hypoallergenic, phthalate-free, latex-free. The internal skeleton is a titanium-aluminium alloy with biomechanically articulated joints. Full material datasheet available on request.

We do not request card details on the site. After you submit your request a private advisor contacts you and you agree the method together — cash on delivery or card via mobile terminal. The statement reads “Velvet Studio SRL” with no reference to the content.

items.q: Can a purchased companion be returned?
items.a: Per EU Directive 2011/83 art. 16(e), unsealed intimate goods are excluded from the 14-day right of withdrawal for hygiene reasons. In case of manufacturing defect, contact us within 24 hours and we will repair or replace the piece.

items.q: Is there a warranty on purchases?
items.a: Yes. Every purchased companion includes 12 months of technical support for the skeleton and electronic modules. The outer skin is warranted for 6 months against manufacturing defects under normal use.

Pick an interval (4 hours to 7 days), confirm address and time, and we deliver the sealed companion within the agreed window. At the end of the period a courier collects it back inside an opaque bag. The courier interaction is non-verbal.
Rentals require a refundable deposit set with your advisor based on the model (typically 100–300 EUR). The deposit is fully refunded at the end of the period after an integrity check.

items.q: What happens to my data after we finish?
items.a: Your name, address and phone are encrypted and kept strictly for the logistics of the order. Within 30 days of delivery/return at the latest, the data is purged from the active database. We can issue a written confirmation on request (dpo@velvet-companions.com).

about.title: About Velvet Companions
about.lede: Velvet Companions is the Romanian studio that produces and operates rentals of premium realistic companions, with clinical hygiene standards and an unconditional discretion policy.

pillars.heading: Why we started
pillars.body: Born from a private workshop in 2024, the brand appeared as a response to a concrete problem: the European market for realistic companions was polarised between low-cost products with questionable materials and bespoke pieces with six-month lead times. We wanted a middle path — controlled manufacturing, an option to test through rental, and support in three languages for a regional market until now served only from outside the EU.

pillars.heading: What we do differently
pillars.body:
Every model we rent or sell passes through an internal technical evaluation on 14 criteria — from joint tolerances to skin resistance to solvents. The rejection rate is between 20% and 30% per batch. Models that enter the catalogue are then photographed in natural light, without retouching, so there are no surprises at delivery.

Between rentals every companion goes through a five-step hygiene protocol documented per cycle. Buyers receive the same level of preparation plus 12 months of technical support for the internal skeleton and 6 months for the outer skin.

pillars.heading: Who we work for
pillars.body: Our clients are mostly adults between 30 and 55, with stable incomes, who value discretion above price. The majority of enquiries come from Romania, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. Our working languages are Romanian, English and Dutch — each adviser is fluent in at least two.
